{"final":{"summary":"Order-router is the only service in this window showing clear failure: its ERROR logs start at 2026-03-12T13:10:07Z with `KeyError 'limit_price'` in place_order, and its err_rate rises to a max of 0.305 (last 0.303) against a min of 0.003. Orchestrator and broker-gateway error rates stay near baseline (about 0.004 to 0.007), and orchestrator logged no ERROR lines in the window. {"final":{"summary":"Three searches returned only three past incidents, and only INC-0431 closely matches the current symptom. INC-0431 (2026-02-02) was order placement errors caused by a validation regression in an order-router release, fixed by rollback, which makes an order-router release a plausible hypothesis to check. INC-0412 (Redis cache stampede on portfolio-svc) and INC-0388 (bank-side FIP downtime affecting account aggregator fetches) do not match the current signals. These are historical hints only; I did not check current change history, so nothing here confirms a cause for the current incident.","evidence":[{"kind":"FACT","claim":"Past incident INC-0431 had the same symptom as the current incident: order placement errors after a release (historical hint, not current evidence).","excerpt":"Order placement errors after a release","source_call_id":"T5-01","service":"order-router"},{"kind":"FACT","claim":"Past incident INC-0431 root cause was a validation regression in an order-router release.","excerpt":"Validation regression in order-router release","source_call_id":"T5-01","service":"order-router"},{"kind":"FACT","claim":"Past incident INC-0431 was resolved by rolling back the order-router revision.","excerpt":"Rolled back the order-router revision","source_call_id":"T5-01","service":"order-router"},{"kind":"FACT","claim":"Past incident INC-0412 (2026-01-18) had a different root cause, a Redis restart and cache stampede on portfolio-svc, so it does not match the current order-placement symptom.","excerpt":"Redis restart evicted hot context, cache stampede on portfolio-svc","source_call_id":"T5-03","service":"redis-cache"},{"kind":"FACT","claim":"Past incident INC-0388 (2025-12-09) concerned account aggregator fetch failures from bank-side downtime, which is not related to order placement.","excerpt":"Account aggregator data fetch failures for one bank","source_call_id":"T5-03","service":"aa-sync"},{"kind":"ASSUMPTION","claim":"INC-0431 is the closest historical match, but its similarity is only at the symptom level.
